# What LeakSanitizer is told to pass over in the sanitizer job.
#
# The colour conversion tests run on the software Vulkan driver, which keeps
# allocations of its own until the process ends and never frees them; every
# one of them is allocated from inside the driver's library. They are the
# driver's to leak and nothing this workspace can free, so they are named
# here by library rather than by switching leak detection off for the code
# the job exists to check.
leak:libvulkan_lvp.so
# Pulled in by an implicit Vulkan layer on a desktop machine, so the job can
# be run there too; nothing in this workspace links it.
leak:libdbus-1.so
